resources.string: Real hinge is offline: Shizuku stopped
Off. The fold effect runs on its learned timings.
Shizuku isn\'t running. Install it and start it (it has to be started again after every reboot), then come back here.
Shizuku is running. Allow Duos to use it.
Connected. The fold effect follows the hinge\'s true angle, and the screens change early. %1$s

Inner screen as the phone starts to open (One UI waits for about 92°), front screen while it is still closing (One UI waits for about 5°). Left to One UI while a camera is in front or a phone call is up.

The same effect as on Home, drawn over whatever app is open, the lock screen included. Needs \"Duos gestures & overlays\" switched on in Android\'s Accessibility settings: that service is what may draw above other apps. Touches always pass through it.
The soft edge ahead of the dark blurs the app underneath, from a private copy of the screen that never leaves the phone\'s graphics memory. Protected screens (banking, films) show dark instead.
Needs the real hinge above to be connected. Until then the dark edge crosses without the blur ahead of it.

Draws the frosted and dark part of the effect at half resolution over the sharp screen: a quarter of the work, so fewer dropped frames. What is clear stays full resolution. Compare a few folds each way.
One soft dark front crosses the whole screen: right to left on the front screen as the phone opens, again across the inner screen, so the panels always change under dark.

Apple\'s way, following the real hinge: the picture stays where it is, and the half that moves shows it in perspective, blurred and darker the further it is from flat, coming into focus as the phone opens. The front screen does the same toward its free edge, and a still of it carries across to the inner screen. Best with the real hinge connected; over other apps it needs \"Frost what\'s underneath\" for the pictures.
Apps fly back into their icons
Swiping home lands the app in its icon, and opening one grows evenly while Home zooms toward it.
Apps grow out of their icons (new)
A rounded card grows from the icon to the whole screen, showing the app as you last left it when the real hinge is connected. New and not yet tuned by eye: switch it off if a launch ever looks wrong.

Every app you installed follows the phone\'s rotation and fills the 4:3 inner screen, as Samsung\'s per-app Full screen setting does, instead of sitting in a box. An app restarts as its setting changes, so music that is playing stops for a moment. Turn it off for one app from its long-press panel; Samsung\'s own apps are left as they are.
Needs the real hinge (Shizuku) above to be connected: that is what may change an app\'s screen setting.
